## 专业说明 {#overview}

<p><strong>官方名称：</strong>Universitaire Pabo van Amsterdam</p>

<p><strong>授予学位 / 项目类型：</strong>Hbo-bachelor leraar basisonderwijs + wo-bachelor pedagogische wetenschappen</p>

<p><strong>目录适用期：</strong>Current official directory, checked 2026-09-12</p>

<p><strong>条目类型：</strong>joint dual bachelor programme</p>

<p><strong>申请路径：</strong>Combined university pedagogical sciences bachelor and professional primary-school-teacher bachelor; explicit double diploma on official programme page.</p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>学习内容：</strong>将小学教师培养与教育科学相结合，兼顾小学教学资格路径和教育理论。</p>
